content_sections.heading: Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Graduate or Post-Graduate degree in any discipline with at least 40% marks, and must have passed the Matriculation (10th) examination with Marathi as one of the subjects. Preference will be given to candidates who have pursued a Bachelor's or Master's degree in B.Com, B.A., B.Sc. (IT/Agriculture/Maths/Statistics), or a Degree/Post Graduate Degree in Computer and IT-related disciplines such as B.C.A. or other equivalent qualifications. Note: the age-limit section of the official notification specifies the reference date as 31 August 2026, while the general instructions section separately mentions 31 August 2025. This appears to be an inconsistency within the official document itself. Candidates are advised to confirm the correct reference date directly from the bank before applying. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Salary 2026

After successful completion of probation, subject to satisfactory performance, the probationary Clerk will be placed in the Bank's regular Clerk grade and paid total emoluments as per the bank's Clerk pay scale. The exact pay scale and detailed salary structure after confirmation are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.text: Selection for the post of Clerk will be based on an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview. The online examination pattern is as follows. The online examination will be conducted in English and Marathi, with a duration of 75 minutes. Candidates must score a minimum of 50% (45 marks) as cut-off marks to be shortlisted for the personal interview; the bank reserves the right to increase or decrease this cut-off. Shortlisting for interview is also subject to validation of educational qualifications and experience based on submitted documents. The final merit list will be prepared in descending order based on combined scores from the online examination and the interview. The personal interview will be held at Sindhudurg.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Sindhudurg DCC Bank recruitment portal at sindhudurgdcc.bank.in/recruitment2026. Keep a scanned colour photograph (80 KB to 200 KB) and signature ready in JPEG/JPG format. Keep scanned copies of 10th, 12th, Graduate, Post-Graduate certificates, and Domicile Certificate ready (80 KB to 200 KB, JPEG/JPG format). Ensure you have an active personal email ID and mobile number, as the bank will send communication such as hall ticket intimation through the registered email ID. Pay the application fee of Rs. 900/- offline through NEFT, IMPS, or Account Transfer to the bank account specified in the notification, and note the Transaction ID. Fill in the online application form, upload the required documents and proof of fee payment, and choose up to three preferred examination centre districts. Review all entered details carefully, as applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified. Submit the application and take a printout of the completed form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by The Sindhudurg District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Sindhudurg, to fill 67 vacancies for the post of Clerk through an online examination and personal interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 67 vacancies for the post of Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 17 September 2026 (11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A Graduate or Post-Graduate degree in any discipline with at least 40% marks, along with passing Matriculation with Marathi as one subject, is required. Candidates with degrees in commerce, science, IT, agriculture, mathematics/statistics, or computer applications will be preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 40 years as on 31 August 2026. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 763/- plus 18% GST, totalling Rs. 900/-, payable offline via NEFT, IMPS, or Account Transfer. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official portal at sindhudurgdcc.bank.in/recruitment2026 by registering, uploading the required documents, and completing the offline fee payment process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Sindhudurg DCC Bank Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an online examination (90 questions, 90 marks, 75 minutes) followed by a personal interview, with the final merit list prepared using combined scores.
